channel.desc: Taste the Layer, Feel the Pair.Annyeonghaseyo, Hello, Buongiorno!Every bite in balance. Every table, complete! Chef Fabri is deeply devoted to Korean cuisine,and what he creates is something more than just a meal. Kimchi, bulgogi, gimbap?Korean food is now celebrated around the world as K-food. But real Korean cuisine goes beyond what?s on the plate.It?s about where the ingredients come from,and how they come together. Fabri, an Italian chef who has truly fallen for Korean food,sets out on a journey across Koreain search of the perfect balance of a complete Korean table. Along the way, he meets local people,finds inspiration in each moment,and brings his own culinary instinct to every dish,all coming together as one complete table. This is not just a cooking show.It?s a moment where food, drinks, and people connect,capturing a truly Korean way of dining. Join Chef Fabriand discover the most perfect pairing of K-food.
